notes: A disabled button with a tooltip still shows it, so you can see why it is off.
Dropdowns where you pick a value show an up-and-down arrow, menus keep the down arrow. Both are side by side in Inputs.
The tile map shows a layer over the map and under the pins, such as a fog of war.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Patch notes for this module start with this version.
